svg.aria-label: One-way light time between Mars and Earth for every day from 2026-11-01 to 2040-12-31
svg.text: How long a message takes from Mars to Earth
One-way light time for every day, November 2026 to December 2040. NASA/JPL data, checked day by day against JPL Horizons.
No link: Mars is within 2° of the Sun as seen from Earth and commanding stops. 7 times in these years, 10 to 17 days each.
Table: data/mars_link.json, from JPL's approximate planetary elements. Largest difference with JPL Horizons over 5,175 days: 0.29 s.
